_comment: Single source of truth for product-image mapping. A product code is the permanent identity of its image set. LOCKED entries must not be remapped, reordered or overwritten by any import; changing one requires an explicit unlock. Never infer assignment from array position, product number, filename order or alphabetical order.

SB-BAG-01.source: supplied by the shop in chat, 18 Aug 2026; three photographs, not stored

authenticity.claimed: listed and described by the shop as Michael Kors
indicators: offered at Rs 3,500 against a retail figure many times higher
described as 12@ grade, which is replica grading rather than a brand term
sold on the inclusion of branded box, dust cover, tags and hanging charm
hangtag in the supplied photograph reads MICHAEL / MIOAHI / KORR
authenticity.note: Not asserted either way. The shop was explicit that no authenticity claim should be invented, and none is made here.

publication.reason: The photographs carry the Michael Kors wordmark, the repeated MK monogram across the body of the bag and the circular MK charm. Offering the piece for sale on a public page under those marks is trademark use in commerce, and the exposure falls on the shop. The record is kept; the listing is not published.
publication.unblockedBy: evidence of source -- invoice, distributor or equivalent. With that, remove hold:true, add the photographs, and it lists in full with the brand name and logo intact.
